summary: APM feed s077_single is degraded due to tool overload: 17.14 Gbps bursts exceed the 10 Gbps APM port (171% capacity, 2 intervals). All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, packet_drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker forwards aggregated traffic that bursts to 17.14 Gbps in 1 ms intervals to a single 10 Gbps APM port, exceeding line rate by 71% and overflowing port buffers. 2 intervals exceeded the 80% (8 Gbps) safe threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will drop packets during bursts, causing incomplete transaction/flow records, inaccurate latency and throughput metrics, and missed application performance degradations despite needing both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2x10G APM members to keep per-port utilization below 80% and absorb 17+ Gbps bursts without loss, preserving complete APM visibility.
